pkgmetadata.longdescription: networkd-dispatcher is a dispatcher daemon for systemd-networkd connection status changes, similar to NetworkManager-dispatcher. It listens over D-Bus for systemd-networkd operational state changes and runs executable, root-owned scripts placed in per-state directories (routable.d, dormant.d, etc.) under /etc/networkd-dispatcher and /usr/lib/networkd-dispatcher.

use.flag: Install net-wireless/iw for wireless interface (ESSID) support
